newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Fire, explosion hit Taiwan's Taoyuan refinery.
newsitem.headline: Fire, explosion hit Taiwan's Taoyuan refinery.

text.p: Taiwan state oil monopoly Chinese Petroleum said a fire late on Thursday at its northern refinery at Taoyuan had triggered explosions but that the extent of damage and possible injuries were not known.

"We learned from our internal emergency communications system that there has been a fire and explosion at the Taoyuan refinery, but we have no more details," a Chinese Petroleum executive told Reuters from the monopoly's Taipei office.
The refinery's offices could not be reached by telephone.
The Taoyuan refinery, which mainly serves the domestic Taiwan market, is Chinese Petroleum's main production facility for jet oil and serves the nearby Taipei international airport.

The accident at Taoyuan was the second to hit Taiwan's oil giant on Thursday, coming just hours after a two-minute power outage in southern Kaohsiung that forced a shutdown of its huge No.5 naphtha cracker and a score of affiliated plants.
